answer: Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the quartz binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. Honest users pay that once, farms 30 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
